notes: Two added units, both italic in the ASV: the supplied *For*, for a clause with no conjunction morpheme in it (rule 14), and the supplied object *our speech* (rule 44).

The `מִ פְּנֵי` grouping was re-tested and retained: *by reason of* is one compound English rendering of which no morpheme owns a part (rule 30), headed on the construct noun and on *reason* (rules 23, 24).
